title: Platform test checklist: add items for the list column-header menu and for reordering sort levels
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filed from the build and review of #35876 (PR #35909). Part of epic #35547 (list page redo).

## Gap
`docs/qa/platform-checklist/` has no item that drives the two behaviours #35876 adds to the list page:
1. Clicking a column header opens a menu (sort ascending / descending, add to the existing sort, hide column) instead of replacing the whole sort; a non-sortable header opens the menu without sort entries.
2. Reordering the levels of a multi-level sort in the sort panel (drag, and arrow keys).

The nearest item, `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder`, covers building a sort, not the header menu or the reorder.

## To do
Author the items (or extend the nearest one) with steps, expected results and fixtures, in the checklist's own shape, after #35909 merges so the steps match the shipped UI.

## Acceptance
- `check-platform-checklist` is OK and the new or extended items name #35876.

Reader: `domain:ui` / QA checklist.
